name: Question 12
problem:
Calculate the value of 
$\,|\begin{aligned}3 & 9 & -6 & -3 \\ -5 & -6 & 10 & 12 \\ 2 & 2 & -1 & -1 \\ 4 & 8 & -8 & -2\end{aligned}|.$

*Hint: Use elementary column operations to make the entries to the right of ${a}_{11}$ equal to zero. You should be able to reduce the given $4\times 4$ determinant to a $3\times 3$ determinant.*
worked_solution:
Using elementary column operations, let's make entries to the right of ${a}_{11}=3$ equal to zero.

Since adding a multiple of one row (or column) to another row (column) in a matrix does not change the value of its determinant, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,|\begin{aligned}3 & 9 & -6 & -3 \\ -5 & -6 & 10 & 12 \\ 2 & 2 & -1 & -1 \\ 4 & 8 & -8 & -2\end{aligned}| &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{2}:={C}_{2}+(-3){C}_{1} \\ {C}_{3}:={C}_{3}+2{C}_{1} \\ {C}_{4}:={C}_{4}+{C}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -5 & 9 & 0 & 7 \\ 2 & -4 & 3 & 1 \\ 4 & -4 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the result along the $1$st row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,|\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -5 & 9 & 0 & 7 \\ 2 & -4 & 3 & 1 \\ 4 & -4 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 7 \\ -4 & 3 & 1 \\ -4 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot |\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 7 \\ -4 & 3 & 1 \\ -4 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot (3)\cdot (-1)^{2+2}|\begin{aligned}9 & 7 \\ -4 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =9(18+28) \\  & =9(46) \\  & =414.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 12
?

Calculate the value of |39−6−3−5−6101222−1−148−8−2|.

Hint: Use elementary column operations to make the entries to the right of a11 equal to zero. You should be able to reduce the given 4×4 determinant to a 3×3 determinant.

a
531
b
298
c
462
d
414
e
378
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Using elementary column operations, let's make entries to the right of a11=3 equal to zero.

Since adding a multiple of one row (or column) to another row (column) in a matrix does not change the value of its determinant, we obtain

=|39−6−3−5−6101222−1−148−8−2|C2:=C2+(−3)C1C3:=C3+2C1C4:=C4+C1=|3000−59072−4314−402|.

Expanding the result along the 1st row, we get

=|3000−59072−4314−402|=3⋅(−1)1+1|907−431−402|=3⋅|907−431−402|=3⋅(3)⋅(−1)2+2|97−42|=9(18+28)=9(46)=414.
